title: The Shape of Things to Come
summary: A thought-provoking essay by former Google/Amazon engineer Steve Yegge exploring the future trajectory of AI technology and its implications for software development and society.
problem_solved: Helps technical professionals understand where AI technology is heading and how to prepare for the coming changes.
why_valuable: Steve Yegge offers rare insider perspective from both Google and Amazon, providing uniquely informed predictions about AI's future impact on software engineering.
